text:
anya: Heads up — PR #8592 is ready but blocked on architecture review. I linked the RFC in the PR description: https://r.redwood/rfcs/54 — change is routing policy + shard assignment tweaks. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/8592

sam: cc @leo @maria — can you take a look? Do we need a short sync or can this be async? :eyes:

leo: I'll skim now. Main concern is graceful fallbacks and any SLO delta. Please add a short canary plan in the PR so we can validate impact.

maria: Agree with leo. Add SLO impact table + explicit rollback conditions. Product wants a 0.5% error rate rollback threshold.

anya: Thanks — I added a minimal canary section and an SLO table in the PR description. Snippet I added:
```
canary: 5% traffic for 2h
metric: p95 latency <= +20ms
rollback: error rate > 0.5% or p95 > +50ms
```

devops-bot: Deploy-check: infra tests passed ✅ (build 4821)

sam: quick note — the RFC link points to v1 draft. Can you switch to canonical v2? https://r.redwood/rfcs/54-v2 and mention what changed from v1.

anya: Good catch, updated PR to use v2 and added a short diff note. Also adjusted cache TTL to match RFC v2 recommendations.

leo: LGTM from architecture pending one nit: make shard reassignment idempotent on partial failures. Add a retry/backoff comment in code + a note in the RFC section of the PR.

anya: Will add that. Pushing a tiny fix and a unit test now.

anya: Pushed fix + test. @sam @maria if no objections I plan to merge tomorrow 10:00 PT to hit the release window.

sam: sounds good to me. @maria?

maria: :thumbsup: approved from product. Please include rollback playbook link in PR before merge.

anya: Done — playbook link included in PR description. Tagging for merge slot.

devops-bot: Merge eligible after 1 approvals and CI green.

leo: :white_check_mark: architecture ack. Wait for CI green then merge.

sam: I'll merge once CI is green and confirm the canary rollout triggers as expected.
